requested_changes.requirement: Deliveries exceeding an endpoint's allowance must wait without consuming a retry attempt.

verdict.scope_summary: All three atomic requests are fully communicated. The largest in-scope effect is the new endpoint allowance gate with a separate durable wait-and-recheck loop, including routing resumed deliveries through that gate. The largest surrounding effect is the vertical expansion of the endpoint-state section and movement of the existing delivery queue; these are necessary accommodations for the inserted flow rather than unrelated redesign. No collateral rework, removals of prior meaning, or changes to unrelated ingress, delivery/retry, dead-letter, or operations objects are present.
